value.rationale: The primary source explicitly asks which natural fragments remain axiomatizable. Flatness and excluding quantifiers from conditional scopes are standard, mathematically motivated restrictions, and propositional flat fragments admit dedicated proof systems. Showing that arithmetic survives both restrictions, with only three predicates and three conditional templates, gives a sharp negative boundary that materially narrows the open fragment problem.
